name: ChiShona
economy:
Makoini emutambo chete. Hapana mari chaiyo, kubheja kana kuchinjanisa nemari chaiyo.
/daily: 100 makoini mumaawa 24
/earn: 10 makoini paminiti
/pay: kutumira 1-10000 makoini mushure mekuongorora
fallback: Mutauro uyu uchiri kushandisa Chirungu panenge pasina shanduro.
cooldown: Mirira masekonzi {seconds} usati washandisa mumwe murairo.
error_timeout: Sevhisi yatora nguva yakareba. Edza zvakare gare gare.
error_network: Netiweki haisi kuwanikwa parizvino. Edza zvakare gare gare.
error_storage: Nzvimbo yekuchengetera haisi kuwanikwa. Hapana zvakaedzwa kudzorerwa pakutanga. Bata mutariri.
error_download: Kudhawunirodha kwakundikana. Tarisa chinongedzo woedza zvakare.
error_service: Sevhisi haisi kuwanikwa kana kuti iri kushanda nezvimwe. Edza zvakare gare gare.
error_input: Tarisa zvawaisa kana nguva yekumirira. Shandisa /help kuti uone manyorerwo acho.
error_internal: Murairo uyu watadza kupedza. Ipa mutariri nhamba iyi yekutevera.
help_intro:
Mirairo inotanga ne {prefix}.
{prefix}menu inoratidza mirairo.
{prefix}help command inoratidza mashandisirwo.
Kudhawunirodha kune miganhu yehukuru nenguva.

rules_summary: Mitemo yemibairo: zuva nezuva {daily}; kuwana {earn}; mirira masekonzi {seconds} usati wawana zvakare; makoini akawanda anobvumidzwa {maxBalance}.
welcome_default: Mauya {user} mu {group}! Shandisa /rules kuti uone mitemo yeboka.
coverage: Mitauro {registered} yakanyoreswa; mafaira emitauro {files}; shanduro dzese dzemashandisirwo {complete} dzakazara. Pane makiyi asipo panoshandiswa Chirungu.
locale_partial: Shanduro haisati yakazara; pane makiyi asipo panoshandiswa Chirungu.
locale_complete: Shanduro yemashandisirwo yakazara; mashoko ezvimwe zvinowedzerwa zvekare anogona kunge achiri muchiChirungu.
